scripts.dev: echo 'Run bun run dev:web and then cap:sync'
scripts.build:android: cd ../web && NEXT_BUILD_MODE=export next build && cd ../mobile && cap sync android && cap open android
scripts.build:android:release: cd ../web && NEXT_BUILD_MODE=export next build && cd ../mobile && cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.build:android:debug: cd ../web && NEXT_BUILD_MODE=export next build && cd ../mobile && cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
